E ventgroup entries shall set the Reserved fields to 0x00 and 0x000 .

A SubscribeEventgroupAck entry shall set the type to 0x07.
A SubscribeEventgroup Ack entry shall set the TTL field to the value of the SubscribeEventgrou p entry , it acknowledges .
A SubscribeEventgroupNack entry shall set the type to 0x07.

The Service Discovery may also detect reboots based on the unicast information.

A reboot detected with Session ID and Reboot Flag shall lead to expiration of the local state that is controlled by this communication partner.
